jobs.tierReason: changes lane routing, spend-adjacent scheduling, a config-restoring guard process and review context building
jobs.prompt: Review coordination/review/s13.diff (changes to the swarm tools since 1.136.0). Focus: (1) tools/router.mjs: the cheapest-first order is now cursor, codex, anthropic, openrouter and the claude lane gets midModel and expensiveModel; could any job go to a lane that cannot accept it, or a sensitive job reach a wrong lane; (2) tools/ticket-manifest.mjs: pinned lanes drop cacheContext and take a model from the machine config, and ticket ids in context are expanded through tools/ticket-refs.mjs; could expansion leak a protected or secret file into a worker context, loop, or pull in a huge file list; (3) tools/scope-commands.mjs sync: laterIds transitive closure and the ownership wait; any way a ticket now skips a test file that should block it, or an infinite loop; (4) tools/concurrency-guard.mjs: the marker file and watcher process that restores machineConcurrency; races, restoring a value the owner changed, a crash leaving the config wrong; (5) tools/lanes.mjs queue and tools/acceptance.mjs evaluate fallback. Report only real defects with file and line. Finish with a verdict line: pass or fail, then the findings.
